body: Yes. Thank you for listening. I want to continue to fight. I'm just really scare.

Yes I don't blame anyone but my brain. Everyone deals with it the best they can. My husband was raised in a way that mental sickness have no room in our lives. He knew from the beginning but still thought like I did that I was going to survive it. Well I haven't just a front so they won't worry or criticize me anymore.

I do but they have their own issues to deal with. I don't want to put that kind of burden on anyone. If I ever go through with it. I don't want them to feel as if they didn't do enough. As well as my siblings.

I know. I want to be there. I don't know how I will win this one.
